title: Source-story analysis and visual redraw

states.uploadingValidation: After upload, the video is checked for format and integrity before content analysis begins.
states.completed: Source-story script and production assets generated
states.redirecting: Opening script and production asset review…

progress.generating: Generating visual-redraw storyboards from the source story

audioSubtitleNotice: Verbatim subtitles reconstruct the source story without rewriting. Depending on the selected mode, the system transcribes missing ranges or the complete audio track.

brief.label: Visual redraw requirements
brief.help: Specify only visual style, character appearance, and location design. Source dialogue, plot, functional relationships, and event order remain unchanged.

errors.generic: The task could not be completed. Please retry.
errors.analysis: Video analysis failed. Retry, and check the analysis model connection if the problem continues.
errors.videoPreprocess: The source video could not be read or preprocessed. Verify the file, codec support, object storage, and FFmpeg.
errors.audioTranscription: Source dialogue transcription failed. Retry; generation will not continue with incomplete subtitles.
errors.audioModelUnsupported: No audio transcription capability is available. Configure ASR or use a Gemini analysis model that supports audio input.
errors.frameProcessing: Key-frame extraction or storage failed. Check FFmpeg, object storage connectivity, and free storage space.
errors.modelRequest: The analysis-model request failed. Check the model configuration, endpoint, credentials, quota, and network.
errors.modelResponseInvalid: The model responded, but its output did not match the video-analysis contract. Retry or choose a stronger multimodal instruction-following model.
errors.reportAggregation: Shot analysis completed, but the combined timeline or source-story report was invalid. Retry the analysis.
errors.storyboardGeneration: Source-story visual redraw failed. Retry will keep the analysis result instead of analyzing the video again.
errors.invalidReport: The analysis report is invalid. Please retry the analysis.
errors.projectMismatch: This analysis task does not belong to the current project.
